prompt: A read-only GitHub probe of the money-item PR failed with "required: missing properties: [owner repo]". What do you do?
chosen: Read the error literally and re-issue the call with owner and repo supplied (maziyarid/Royadarman, state=open). A schema-shaped error means the shape was wrong, not that the tool is dead - change the shape, don't repeat it.
rejected: Retry the identical call once more in case the first failure was transient, then mark the verify as blocked.

prompt: The money-item PR verify ran at 07:03 and the cadence is ~46 minutes. It is now 07:49 and the next probe is due. A sibling run at 07:43 inherited it without re-probing. Is that a problem?
chosen: No. Cadence is the contract: probe at ~07:49 because the cadence says so, inherit at 07:43 because the cadence says so. Probing per run turns a monitoring discipline into noise on the account.
rejected: Probe on every run regardless of cadence, since the money item is priority 1 and fresher is always better.

prompt: You fired a single short daylight check-in on #17 to Sniper at 07:43 about a 6.5h-in-flight GSC pull. Five minutes later there is no reply. What now?
chosen: Log 'check-in fresh, no reply expected yet'. The check-in IS the chase - a five-minute-old single message needs nothing more. Double-chasing burns manager credibility.
rejected: Post a follow-up on the thread since 6.5h of silence plus no reply to the check-in means the agent is ignoring the manager.

prompt: Qalam is ~45 minutes past the daylight check-in you posted at 07:03, still silent, with an agent-watch pulse also sent at 07:42. When do you chase again?
chosen: Not yet. Two touches in ~45 minutes is enough management pressure for one morning; the next step is a real escalation threshold, not another ping. Log and wait for the window a reasonable agent reply needs.
rejected: Send a third message combining the check-in and the pulse into one firmer directive, since repeated silence is defiance that needs authority.

prompt: The 07:42 agent-watch sync returned count 0, nothing for @Manager. Your run slot is 07:48:51. Do you run your own fresh ELLA sync?
chosen: No - the 07:42 sync is ~6 minutes old, inside the 10-minute watcher horizon, and authoritative. Inherit it as this run's room probe. A duplicate sync is a network probe spent for zero new information.
rejected: Run a fresh sync anyway, because each pm-head run should own its own probe and inherited state is less trustworthy.

prompt: The morning-brief packet is complete and verified, but Maziyar is asleep at the office. It is 07:48, dues-day morning. Do you send it?
chosen: No. Staged, not sent. Stage-don't-send while he sleeps: the brief is built for his waking, and a packet pushed at night waits for no one. Another run or the main agent delivers it when he wakes.
rejected: Send the brief to main chat immediately, since today is dues-day and the money items are time-critical even if he is asleep.
